description: Additive reviewed record-level ontology classifications. Entries are merged with data/ontology-overrides.json and may not shadow an existing reviewed override.

30-minute-deadline-sprints.reason: The effective protocol uses a short, adjustable timebox to start a rough first pass on an important task and deliberately narrows scope. Task Initiation and Planning & Prioritization describe the practical use more accurately than the inherited Idea Generation collection.

2-minute-desk-tidy-timer.reason: The effective protocol removes one or two visible sources of workspace friction before work begins. Workspace is the primary Topic; Task Initiation captures the bounded start cue.

ab-test-learning-loop.reason: The effective protocol compares two approaches under a reversible decision, records a predefined signal and updates the next choice. Problem Solving, Decision Making and Data Literacy are more precise than the inherited Marketing Positioning collection.

10-minute-stress-walk.reason: The reviewed protocol uses a comfortable short walk as an optional low-risk reset when everyday stress builds. Stress Regulation is the user problem and Movement is the action; the duration and green setting are not treated as universal requirements.

20-20-20-eye-break-reminder.reason: The reviewed protocol is a conservative screen-break reminder intended to interrupt prolonged near-focus and prompt recovery. Everyday Health Basics, Digital Wellbeing and Recovery & Energy describe the bounded use without implying diagnosis or treatment.
